messages:
eva (support): P1 from Acme — they're seeing ~30-40% 5xx/timeouts against hosted inference in eu-west-1 since 10:03 UTC. Customers report rapid failures after a short period. Escalating now. :rotating_light:
maria (eng-runtime): seeing spike on our side too. Error groups point to auth-proxy returning 502/504 to the gateway. Metrics: 8x error rate on /v1/infer cluster eu-west-1 since 10:05.
kevin (eng-sre): alert: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ABC123/hosted-errors?from=now-1h to=now — useful to correlate tokens/sec vs failures. I can see increased latency to KMS and some 429s to the key service around 10:02-10:06.
eva (support): customer provided sample request + response: "curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"hi"}'" -> returns 502 with body "upstream auth proxy failed".
maria: repro from our infra: ran curl from eu-west pod and saw auth-proxy attempt to refresh token then returned 502. Relevant log: 
```
2026-03-17T10:04:21Z auth-proxy ERROR token_refresh failed status=429 body="rate limit"
2026-03-17T10:04:21Z auth-proxy ERROR upstream_handling error=failed_to_fetch_token
2026-03-17T10:04:21Z gateway WARN request_id=... returning 502 to client
```
kevin: so chain looks like KMS/requested token refresh -> 429 (throttle) -> auth-proxy can't get token -> gateway responds 502/504. That matches KMS quota exhaustion/burst.
sam (product): any customer-facing impact beyond Acme? ETA to mitigation?
eva: on support tickets we have 5 customers reporting elevated errors in EU (Acme, BetaCorp, Clinicly, Zeta). Some are in mid-run inference jobs that started encountering failures after ~30s.
maria: quick mitigation idea: auth-proxy can fall back to cached token for short TTL when KMS returns 429. I can prepare a hotfix to skip refresh for a bounded window (e.g., 30s) and increment a metric. Also roll a config to enable circuit-breaker at gateway so failing auth-proxy responses return 503 with faster failover to fallback cluster.
kevin: short term ops mitigation: 1) increase KMS burst quotas (I will open support/ops ticket with cloud provider now), 2) enable routing fallback to dedicated pool in eu-west if gateway sees auth-proxy 5xx > 5% for 2 mins, 3) throttle client concurrency per-token to avoid thundering bursts.
maria: hotfix patch is small, adding cached-token fallback + metric increment + feature flag. I'll push to canary in 10m, monitor.
eva: I'll message affected customers with ETA and workaround: reroute to alternate region (us-west) or retry with exponential backoff.
oncritical: support-bot: incident created #INC-2026-032-11 assigned to eng-sre and eng-runtime.
kevin: ops ticket with cloud KMS opened (ticket# CLOUD-9876) asking for temporary quota bump and to investigate internal throttling.
maria: deploying hotfix to canary eu-west-1 now. Will monitor auth-proxy errors and gateway 5xx.
(5m passes)
maria: canary looks good — auth-proxy 429s replaced by cached-token path; client 5xx rate dropped from 32% -> 6% in canary cohort. Rolling to 50% of EU traffic.
kevin: routing fallback enabled on gateway for eu-west, will keep for 30m. Config ID: fb-2026-03-17-01.
eva: customer update sent to Acme + BetaCorp with recommended retry/backoff and note about temporary routing; they acknowledged.
sam: product note: need to update runbook to include KMS burst handling and fallback token semantics.
maria: followups/action items: 1) auth-proxy: persist cached-token fallback (PR #4256) — maria (done in canary, will merge after tests); 2) eng-sre: request permanent quota bump & monitor KMS error budget — kevin; 3) infra: add circuit-breaker policy to gateway with clearer SLA mapping — sam; 4) support: send final customer postmortem and template — eva.
kevin: I'll schedule a post-incident meeting 11:30 UTC, invite eng-runtime, eng-sre, support, product.
oncall-bot: Incident resolved in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-17T10:23:00Z — marking as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
eva: closing P1 with customers after follow-up messages.
sam: I'll own the postmortem doc and link to follow-ups in the console.
maria: thanks everyone. Will follow up with PR link and rollout schedule. :thumbsup:
